claim_boundary: a placement and connection abstract for licensed PHY IP only; footprint and boundary timing are assumed, the port list is the real controller RTL's PHY side

area_basis.note: as hbm2e; the controller logic previously counted inside this area is now real leaves (no area credit taken)

footprint.depth: area / edge, snapped up to 2.16 um

edge_basis.source: NVIDIA GH100 (814 mm^2) places six HBM3 sites, three along each long edge of the die (NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU Architecture whitepaper, 2022, die shot and 'up to 6 HBM3/HBM2e stacks'); with a ~33 mm long edge that leaves <= 11 mm of shoreline per stack including the keep-out between PHYs, so the PHY itself is taken as 8-9 mm (8.5 mm default, a parameter).  The technology table's 12.0 mm is the 11 mm HBM3E package edge plus keep-out, i.e. the package pitch on the interposer, not the die-side PHY

controller_clock_mhz.note: the PHY-side controller clock; min_period 900 ps

name: ot_hbm3e_phy_rc_e8p5

pins.matches: ot_hbm_svc_sm_stack_native / ot_hbm_svc_native_sector_pipeline_leaves PHY-side ports (row_*, col_*, dram_rvalid, dram_rdata) at NPC = 32
pins.placement: pseudo-channel p's row/column/data bits in [p*window + span] (facing its controller leaf); clk, rst_n in window 16

power.reach: the parent's M5 stripes over the macro, M4-M5 vias (catalog-macro ElementGrid)
